# jumpcloud_policy (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_policy" "example" {
  name = "FileVault Enforcement"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `notes` (String) Notes or description for the policy.
- `state` (String) The state of the policy.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the policy template.
- `values` (String) JSON-encoded policy values/settings.
